title: Michael Jackson: They Don't Care About Us
original_title: Michael Jackson: They Don't Care About Us
overview: Michael Jackson uses impactful images and scenes of strong social appeal to denounce inequality, prejudice, violence and exclusion. With a message of protest and resistance, the clip highlights the struggle of marginalized communities and reinforces a call for justice, respect and social change.
